items.title: The obstruction class for deforming a morphism of ringed topoi

items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma with its three assertions for the deformation problem of a morphism of ringed topoi: there is a canonical class xi in Ext^2_O(L_f, G) whose vanishing is necessary and sufficient for the existence of a solution; when solutions exist their isomorphism classes form a principal homogeneous space under Ext^1_O(L_f, G); and the automorphisms of a solution are canonically Ext^0_O(L_f, G) (source lines 4028-4043). Parts (2) and (3) are transferred from deformation theory through the identifications of the naive cotangent complex with the truncation of L_f and of H^0(L_f) with Omega_f. Part (1) exhibits the deformation-theoretic class xi' in Ext^1_O(Lf^*NL_{O_B/O_B'}, G), rewrites it in terms of L, and observes that the long exact sequence of the distinguished triangle for the pair (f, t) exhibits solvability as exactly the condition that xi' lie in the image of the comparison map, so that its image xi in Ext^2_O(L_f, G) is the obstruction.
